title: Emergency!

Gage's and DeSoto's stands on honesty are put to the test when people who withhold vital information experience different consequences.

title: Emergency!

A woman believes her dead sister is the cause of accidents in her home; a man is trapped underwater in his car with the doors jammed.

Station 51's mascot, Boot, won't eat; accidents befall a woman attempting to cook a meal; a man nearly dies from an aspirin overdose.

B.A. drives in a stock car race to prevent Hannibal's nephew (Ken Olandt) being run off the track by thugs; guest Stuart Whitman.

description:

Pardoned Face's book-promotion TV tour hits a snag when a Viet Cong general seeks revenge for his jilted daughter.

description:

The team conceals in suburbia a rock singer threatened by terrorists, until a nosy neighbor blows the whistle.

title: The A-Team
description:

The team journeys to a South American jungle to rescue Murdock's kidnapped therapist (Richard Anderson); guest Jeannetta Arnette.

title: The A-Team
description:

The mob forces a children's TV-show host (Arte Johnson) to endorse cheap, unsafe Uncle Buckle-Up dolls.

title: The A-Team
description:

Agents detour Murdock to South America when he embarks on a Hawaiian trip he won on "Wheel of Fortune"; guests Pat Sajak, Vanna White.

title: The A-Team
description:

description:

title: The A-Team
description:

description:

To gain access to its gamma ray equipment, David impersonates a scientist inspecting a nuclear research facility.
